paragraphs: Morgan Stanley is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company. It is headquartered at 1585 Broadway in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, with offices in 42 countries, including offices in many financial centers worldwide. Morgan Stanley is one of the largest investment banks by revenue. It is ranked 39th on the Fortune 500 and 21st on the Forbes Global 2000. It is considered a systemically important financial institution by the Financial Stability Board.

The company operates three divisions: institutional services, wealth management (Morgan Stanley Wealth Management), and investment management. The company receives revenues from market making for many types of financial products including equities, fixed income, and commodities (26% of 2025 revenues); net interest income (14% of 2025 revenues); investment management and wealth management (36% of 2025 revenues); investment banking (advisory for mergers and acquisitions and restructuring and securities underwriting, including initial public offerings) (12% of 2025 revenues); commissions and fees for clearing financial transactions (9% of 2025 revenues); and proprietary trading (2% of 2025 revenues).

Morgan Stanley was founded on September 16, 1935, by employees of J.P. Morgan & Co., including Henry Sturgis Morgan (a grandson of J.P. Morgan), Harold Stanley, in response to the Glass–Steagall Act, which required the splitting of American commercial and investment banking businesses. In 1997, the company merged with Dean Witter Discover & Co.. Dean Witter's chairman and CEO, Philip J. Purcell, became the chairman and CEO of the newly merged Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co. The firm changed its name back to "Morgan Stanley" in 2001.

people.name: Mandell L. Crawley
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Client Officer
people.bio: Executive Vice President since February 2021 and Chief Client Officer since January 2025. Previously served as Chief Human Resources Officer and Head of Private Wealth Management.
people.quote: Mandell L. Crawley (50) . Executive Vice President (since February 2021) and Chief Client Officer of Morgan Stanley (since January 2025).

people.name: Eric F. Grossman
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Chief Administrative Officer
people.bio: Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer since January 2012, and Chief Administrative Officer since July 2022. Previously served as Global Head of Legal and was a partner at Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP.
people.quote: Eric F. Grossman (59) . Executive Vice President and Chief Legal Officer of Morgan Stanley (since January 2012)

people.name: Edward Pick
people.title: Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer since January 2024 and Chairman of the Board since January 2025. Previously served as Co-President and Co-Head of Corporate Strategy, and Head of Institutional Securities.
people.quote: Edward Pick (57) . Chairman of the Board of Directors of Morgan Stanley (since January 2025)

people.name: Michael A. Pizzi
people.title: Executive Vice President and Head of Technology and Operations
people.bio: Executive Vice President and Head of Technology and Operations since January 2025; previously Head of U.S. Banks and Head of Technology. Served as Chief Executive Officer of E*TRADE Financial Corporation from August 2019 to October 2020, prior to its acquisition by Morgan Stanley.
people.quote: Michael A. Pizzi (51) . Executive Vice President and Head of Technology and Operations (since January 2025)

people.name: Andrew M. Saperstein
people.title: Co-President and Head of Wealth Management and Investment Management
people.bio: Co-President since June 2021. Previously served as Head of Wealth Management, Co-Head of Wealth Management, and Co-Chief Operating Officer of Institutional Securities.
people.quote: Andrew M. Saperstein (59) . Co-President of Morgan Stanley (since June 2021).

people.name: Daniel A. Simkowitz
people.title: Co-President and Head of Institutional Securities
people.bio: Co-President since January 2024. Previously served as Head of Investment Management, Co-Head of Corporate Strategy, and Co-Head of Global Capital Markets.
people.quote: Daniel A. Simkowitz (60) . Co-President of Morgan Stanley (since January 2024).

people.name: Charles A. Smith
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer since May 2023. Previously served as Head of Institutional Securities Business Development and Chief Financial Officer of Institutional Securities.
people.quote: Charles A. Smith (59) . Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer of Morgan Stanley (since May 2023).

people.name: Sharon Yeshaya
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since June 2021. Previously served as Head of Investor Relations and Chief of Staff in the Office of the Chairman and CEO.
people.quote: Sharon Yeshaya (46) . Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Morgan Stanley (since June 2021).

people.name: Dennis M. Nally
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chair of PricewaterhouseCoopers International Ltd. from 2009 to July 2016. Previously served as Chair and Senior Partner of the U.S. firm of PwC from May 2002 to June 2009.
people.quote: Mr. Nally brings to the Board over 40 years of global regulatory, public accounting and financial reporting experience

people.name: Douglas L. Peterson
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: President and CEO of SPGI from November 2013 to November 2024 and Senior Advisor from November 2024 to December 2025. Previously held senior leadership positions at Citigroup, including Chief Operating Officer of Citibank, N.A.
people.quote: Mr. Peterson has over 40 years of experience in the financial services industry and brings to the Board an international and financial markets perspective.

people.name: Edward Pick
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Chairman of Morgan Stanley since January 2025 and CEO since January 2024. Previously served as Co-President and Co-Head of Corporate Strategy and as Head of Institutional Securities.
people.quote: As CEO of Morgan Stanley, Mr. Pick's over 30 years of experience with the Firm

people.name: Mary L. Schapiro
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Vice Chair for Global Public Policy and Special Advisor to the Founder and Chair of Bloomberg L.P. since October 2018. Previously served as Chair of the SEC, Chair and CEO of FINRA, and Chair of the CFTC.
people.quote: Ms. Schapiro's leadership experience, including at the SEC, FINRA and the CFTC, brings to the Board extensive legal and regulatory compliance

people.name: Perry M. Traquina
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Wellington's CEO and Managing Partner from 2004 through June 2014 and as Chair from 2004 through December 2014. Joined Wellington in 1980 and held several executive roles.
people.quote: Mr. Traquina brings to the Board extensive senior executive, financial services, regulatory and risk management experience

people.name: Rayford Wilkins, Jr.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: CEO of Diversified Businesses of AT&T from October 2008 to March 2012. Previously held numerous management roles at AT&T and began his career at Southwestern Bell Telephone in 1974.
people.quote: Mr. Wilkins brings to the Board extensive leadership, risk management, technology and operational experience

people.name: Robert H. Herz

people.bio: Serves as Audit Committee Chair and is identified as an audit committee financial expert within the meaning of SEC rules.
people.quote: each of Robert H. Herz, the Audit Committee Chair, Lynn J. Good and Dennis M. Nally is an "audit committee financial expert"
